reason: Candidate 5: candidate 4 plus holdout-4 folded into development, 35 transliterated loanwords and 39 identifier-like terms added as training negatives, blind holdout-5 without collision pairs (all 18 pairs of the shipped lexicons are disclosed). Scored once on holdout-5.json: 275 false conversions - `збс` -> `p,c` (208 rows), `хы` -> `[s` (29), `xev` -> `чум` (28), `lz4` (5), `фетч` (5). The shipped candidate 3 converts 476 rows of the same file (`збс` 240, `фетч` 236). Every fresh authored test exposes a correctly typed Russian abbreviation or interjection that the feature-2 character model cannot keep without having seen it; the release policy requires zero false conversions, so the candidate is not promoted and the iteration stops here.
evidence_scope: author-created-synthetic-scenarios-not-real-world-quality; holdout-5.json is now disclosed and may not serve as a new independent test
sources: scenarios-candidate5.json, holdout-5.json and candidate5-changes.patch in this directory
